request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines or vehicles. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the person and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

The person's face is fully visible in three-quarter view, looking at what they are doing, not at the camera.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Two matching objects that differ only in color: the near one is in the person's hands close to the camera, large and sharp; the far one is clearly across the room, about four meters away, smaller but easy to see and in focus, alone on its own piece of furniture against a plain wall, and visible just beside the person's shoulder so that it also stays inside the central 55 percent of the photo width. The two colors are strong and unmistakable. There is no third object of that kind anywhere in the photo.

Image 1 shows Luis. Keep his face, short dark curly hair, clean-shaven face, warm medium-brown skin and build exactly. Create a new photograph of him: he stands in his bright kitchen in his navy T-shirt and holds a WHITE coffee cup in both hands in front of his chest, close to the camera, looking at it. Across the kitchen, on the far counter against a plain wall, there is one BLACK coffee cup of the same shape and size, alone.
